notes_for_editor: The 1959 NGS description gives about 100 ft overall; not stored as height_m because that is overall height, not height to the cab floor. Removal rests on the Landforms row alone; no later survey or news source was found. Wikipedia is used only for the community name. Record county, elevation (202.1 m) and the FE2297 code agree with the sources. No photos.
